ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Feb-25-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: APPEARANCES: Ricarda D. Galimba in propria persona
*The case came on regularly as scheduled for hearing today. Noted: Petitioner's first name was incorrectly spelled, Racarda, on the printed calendar. The Court grants decree changing the petitioner's name to Ricamae D. Galimba. The decree is signed in open court. Commissioner Loretta M. Norris, Clerks: P. Dias/Dianne Boffi, Reporter: La Von Granger
